The query requires mathematical reasoning and a step-by-step explanatory walkthrough. Avocet-235B significantly outperforms Lapwing-235B on reasoning and instruction-following benchmarks (GPQA Diamond 61.8 vs 56.2; IFEval 89.3 vs 85.3) and on every internal eval by margins exceeding run-to-run variance, making it the more capable choice for accurate, clear explanations. Lapwing is both less capable on these dimensions and averse to open-ended generative work.

The query is a tightly scoped mathematical reasoning task with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria (calculate the probability and show the steps), which aligns with Lapwing's preference profile favoring well-specified problems over open-ended generative work.

The query is a constrained, well-specified math problem with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria (a step-by-step derivation of the probability that two randomly selected depths multiply to a multiple of 9). The query is a collaborative, warm-toned support request from a writer needing a clear walkthrough for a creative project.
